title: Landsat P95 Land Surface Temperature Composite
description: A five-year 95th-percentile land surface temperature composite built from landsat-c2-l2 scenes acquired by landsat-8 and landsat-9 between 2021-01-01 and 2025-12-31. Temperature is stored as uint16 and decodes with celsius = dn * 0.01 + (-50.0); DN 0 is nodata. A second asset counts the valid observations behind each pixel, one band per calendar month.
